name: AccentColor
description: Choose the accent colour OmniYap uses for buttons, switches, focus rings and highlights.

name: AlwaysAnimate
description: Never freeze animated avatars, emoji or decorations.

name: AnonymiseFileNames
description: Renames files before upload so original names are not shared.

name: AutoCorrect
description: Fixes common typos and capitalisation when you send a message.

name: BetterGifAltText
description: Gives GIF attachments useful alt text and titles for screen readers and hover.

name: BetterGifPicker
description: A larger GIF picker with more columns and an auto-focused search box.

name: BiggerStreamPreview
description: Makes stream previews in chat considerably larger.

name: CallTimer
description: Shows how long you have been in a voice call.

name: CharacterCounter
description: Shows how many characters you have typed, with a warning near the limit.

name: ClearURLs
description: Removes utm_*, fbclid and other tracking parameters from links.

name: CompactLayout
description: Fits more messages on screen with tighter spacing.

name: ConsoleShortcuts
description: Exposes window.omniyap in DevTools: inspect and toggle plugins, read settings and Yapper's store, and copy diagnostics.

name: CopyEmojiMarkdown
description: Right-click any emoji to copy its :shortcode: or image URL.

name: CopyFileContents
description: Adds a copy button to code blocks in messages.

name: CustomCommands
description: Expand /shortcuts into saved text before a message is sent.

name: CustomFont
description: Changes Yapper's font and text size: presets, an installed family, or a font imported with CustomFontFiles.

name: CustomFontFiles
description: Imports a font file (.woff2/.woff/.ttf/.otf) from your computer and uses it in Yapper. Files stay on this device.

name: CustomIcons
description: Replaces the Home button picture at the top of the server list with your own image. Stored locally.

name: FixImagesQuality
description: Loads images at their original quality instead of a resized thumbnail.

name: FixYoutubeEmbeds
description: Repairs YouTube embeds: privacy-friendly host, no related videos, fullscreen allowed.

name: FocusMode
description: Hides the server list, sidebar and member panel. Ctrl+Shift+F toggles it.

name: ForceOwnerCrown
description: Shows a crown next to your own name everywhere. Purely visual: it grants nothing and nobody else sees it.

name: GifPaste
description: Pasting a direct GIF or video URL sends it as a message.

name: HideAttachments
description: Hide media in a channel with one click (per channel, remembered).

name: HideBadges
description: Removes the badge clutter beside names in chat and tidies up the badges on profile cards.

name: HideClutter
description: Hides the parts of Yapper's interface you never use: upsells, gift buttons, boost bars, the typing line or the member list.

name: HideMedia
description: Hides images, videos and link previews across chat with one toggle, for a calmer, text-only view.

name: ImageFilename
description: Shows the original filename under images and attachments.

name: ImageZoom
description: Click an image to open a full-screen viewer you can zoom and pan.

name: IrcColors
description: Gives every author a stable colour derived from their username, IRC style.

name: JumpToLatest
description: Shows a floating button to jump back to the newest message.

name: KeepCurrentChannel
description: Reopens the channel you were last reading after a reload.

name: MediaActions
description: Hover an image, video or audio attachment to open, download or copy its link.

name: MemberCount
description: Shows the number of members in the open server.

name: MentionAvatars
description: Shows a small avatar inside @mentions.

name: MentionHighlight
description: Tints messages that mention you so they stand out while scrolling.

name: MessageBookmarks
description: Bookmark messages and jump back to them later.

name: MessageClickActions
description: Middle-click to quote, Shift-click to copy a message.

name: MessageLogger
description: Keeps a local log of edited and deleted messages, so nothing disappears silently.

name: MessageStyle
description: Fine-tunes message text: size, line height, spacing, width, bubbles and separators.

name: MoreQuickReactions
description: Adds a row of one-click reactions to every message.

name: NameEffects
description: Adds an animated effect to your name (rainbow, aurora, neon or pulse). Client-side only.

name: NameStyle
description: Styles the names in chat and member lists: weight, size, spacing, capitals and a soft glow.

name: NoBlockedMessages
description: Hides messages from people you blocked, without leaving gaps in the chat.

name: NoF1
description: F1 no longer opens the browser's help page.

name: NoMaskedUrlPaste
description: Pasting a link over selected text inserts the raw URL instead of masking it.

name: NoMiddleClickPaste
description: Middle-clicking the composer no longer pastes the X11 clipboard.

name: NoMosaic
description: Shows multiple image attachments one under another instead of a mosaic.

name: NoOnboardingDelay
description: Skips Yapper's onboarding intro so you land straight in chat.

name: NoPendingCount
description: Hides the little pending/failed counters on channels and messages.

name: NoReplyMention
description: Replies no longer ping the author again.

name: NoServerEmojis
description: Hides the server emoji section from the emoji picker.

name: NoSystemBadge
description: Hides the SYSTEM tag that Yapper shows next to official accounts.

name: NotificationRules
description: Filter desktop notifications by keyword or channel.

name: NoTrack
description: Blocks analytics beacons and third-party tracking requests.

name: NoTypingAnimation
description: Stop the bouncing typing dots; the indicator stays but holds still.

name: oneko
description: A small cat follows your mouse pointer around Yapper. It sits when it reaches you and sleeps when you stop moving.

name: PetPet
description: Pet someone's avatar and watch it wiggle.

name: PictureInPicture
description: Pop any video in chat out into a floating picture-in-picture window.

name: PluginProfiles
description: Save, export and restore whole plugin configurations.

name: PreviewMessage
description: Previews how your message will look (bold, quotes, code, links, lists) before you send it. Ctrl+Shift+P also works.

name: QuickDelete
description: Adds a one-click delete button to messages you are allowed to delete, without Yapper's confirmation window.

name: QuickMention
description: Adds an @ button that mentions the message author in the composer.

name: QuickReply
description: Reply without reaching for the hover menu: double-click, or press R.

name: QuickSwitcher
description: Press Ctrl+K to jump to any channel with fuzzy search.

name: Quoter
description: Quote a message into the composer as a > block.

name: ReadAllNotificationsButton
description: Adds a button that marks every unread channel as read.

name: ReadAloud
description: Reads a message aloud, or every incoming message if you want.

name: ReplyPingDot
description: Shows a dot (amber for replies, red for mentions and DMs) on the chat when someone needs you. It clears when you open that chat.

name: ReplyTimestamp
description: Shows when the message being replied to was originally sent.

name: RevealAllSpoilers
description: Reveal blurred spoilers in chat, without clicking each one.

name: RoundedCorners
description: Rounds the rail, sidebar, chat, cards and media.

name: ScheduleMessages
description: Write a message now and have OmniYap send it later.

name: ServerAccent
description: Gives each server its own accent colour. Buttons, highlights and unread dots change when you open that server. Only you see it.

name: ServerInfo
description: Adds a server info button to the server header: owner, creation date, members, channels, roles and emojis.

name: ServerListIndicators
description: Shows how many friends are online and how many servers you are in, right under the logo in the server list.

name: ShowAllMessageButtons
description: Always show a message's action buttons instead of only on hover.

name: ShowMeYourName
description: Shows the account handle next to a display name, so nicknames are never confusing.

name: SilentTyping
description: Stop sending typing indicators to other people.

name: SmoothTransitions
description: Adds soft transitions to channel changes, hover states and the message list.

name: SplitLargeMessages
description: Long messages are sent in several parts instead of being cut off at 2000 characters.

name: StartupTimings
description: Measures how long Yapper, the mod loader and the store take to become ready.

name: TextReplace
description: Find-and-replace rules for incoming messages (and optionally what you send).

name: ThemeAttributes
description: Adds stable data attributes to messages and the page so themes and Quick CSS can target authors, your own messages and the current channel.

name: TypingTweaks
description: Control the typing indicator's avatars, colour and number of names.

name: Unindent
description: Removes accidental leading indentation from messages before they are sent.

name: UnreadNavigator
description: Jump between unread channels with Alt+Shift+↑/↓.

name: UserMessagesPronouns
description: Shows people's pronouns next to their name in chat.

name: UserNotes
description: Keep private notes about people, stored locally.

name: VcNarrator
description: Uses your system voice to announce who joins or leaves the voice channel you are in.

name: ViewIcons
description: Click an avatar to view and download it at full size.

name: ViewRaw
description: Adds an action to inspect the raw message JSON Yapper has loaded.

name: VolumeBooster
description: Boosts call and media volume above 100% using WebAudio.

name: WebContextMenus
description: Native right-click menus for links, images, selected text and messages.

name: WebKeybinds
description: Alt+↑/↓ channel navigation and Ctrl+Shift+M/D mute and deafen.

name: WordFilter
description: Hides words you never want to see, on your screen only: blurred, covered, or the whole message collapsed. Click a hidden message to reveal it.

name: YoutubeAdblock
description: Filters ad requests in embedded YouTube players.
